title: Detail Description · Teams
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Detail Description · Teams with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Place an ordinary object where everyone can see it. The lead names three visible details without touching or moving the object. The group confirms all three details are visible. Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4–8 players; materials: One household object.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Detail Description, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group confirms all three details are visible.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group confirms all three details are visible.
